text: Let the captains decide. You can expect captives to be executed, humiliated and sent running, or sold as slaves. The foe may not appreciate it, but the troops will.
We are not here for unnecessary bloodshed. It’s the civil thing to do, and hired mercenaries don’t like bad blood.
Show the shackled creatures around and even send back them home for a parade! Everybody likes seeing humiliated evil.
